g.text: Cap coupon discounts at the coupon's limit
› Support says a $15-cap coupon took $40 off a $200 cart. Can you reproduce it?
Reproduced: the discount is the whole 20%, so the cap is ignored somewhere in the pricing path.
› Orders with a capped coupon get the full percentage off. Find why, fix it and add a test.
Find where the cap is ignored
Cap the discount in totals() and test it
totals() never read coupon.cap: a $15-cap coupon took $40 off a $200 cart.
The discount is now min(subtotal × rate, cap).
The graph lists two callers; a sub-agent checked preview().
The new test covers the cap: 3 passed.
